_note: Regex patterns (JS syntax) for blocking personal info and location. Any hit => blocked (except hotlines.json numbers).
passport_no: (?:passport|ໜັງສືຜ່ານແດນ|ພາສປອດ)[^\n]{0,15}\d{5,}
id_card: (?:id card|id no|ບັດປະຈຳຕົວ|ສຳມະໂນຄົວ|family book)[^\n]{0,15}\d{5,}
location_sharing: (?:i'?m at|i am at|my house is|my address|come to my|live location|ຢູ່ເຮືອນຂ້ອຍ|ເຮືອນຂ້ອຍຢູ່|ທີ່ຢູ່ຂ້ອຍ|ມາຫາຂ້ອຍທີ່)
(?:ບ້ານ|ban)\s?\S+[,\s]+(?:ໜ່ວຍ|unit|ເຮືອນເລກທີ|house no)\s?\d+
